_comment: Synthetic categories only — the real one describes a practice's own menu and is
written locally at the RECOVERY_DESIGN.md §7 runbook run, kept outside the repo
Each key is a service category, written either as the source label or as its code
(the label slugged); both resolve to the same category. expectedReturnIntervalDays
is hand-set clinical-cadence judgment and is never derived from the data — null
means the category defines no dormancy at all, and a category absent from this file
is treated the same way. typicalTicketCents is an optional override for a category
with no usable revenue history; without it the ticket is the revenue average.
